name: Docchi no i ga Suki Desu ka?
original_name: どっちのiが好きですか？
source:
Tadaomi is a second-year student at Gouketsukan private school. Since he’ll be busy preparing for university entrance exams next year, he thought that this summer vacation would be the best time to make memories with his girlfriend. But how would he spend his time together with her…? If you were in his place, would you take the lead or leave it all up to her?

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2019/11/21/november-2019-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri~![/url]]
translation:
Tadaomi是豪杰馆私立学校的二年级学生。明年要忙于准备大学入学考试，所以他认为这个暑假是与女朋友留下回忆的最佳时机。可是，他该如何与她共度时光……？如果你处在他的位置，会主动带领她，还是把一切交给她决定？
